_comment: Generated brainrot meshes, by character id.
These are baked into ReplicatedStorage.BrainrotModels by tools/build_place.py.
They CANNOT be applied at runtime: MeshPart.MeshId is not writable from a
script, so a MeshPart has to already exist in the place and be cloned.
native  = the size the generator reported for the raw asset.
target  = what the model's LARGEST dimension should become on a pad.
Largest-dimension rather than height, because these come back in
all shapes and normalising a flat wide one to a standard height
Each entry emits TWO MeshParts: Body keeps the generated texture and is used
for the Normal variant, BodyPlain drops it so Gold/Diamond/Rainbow can take
a colour. Two parts rather than clearing the texture at runtime because
TextureID is the same kind of unwritable Content property as MeshId.
